project.name: llama.cpp
project.description: LLM/VLM inference in plain C/C++ with minimal setup and state-of-the-art performance across CPUs and GPUs (CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, SYCL, CANN, MUSA, etc.), built on the ggml tensor library.

nodes.name: dest.md
nodes.summary: Hardware environment analysis and llama-server tuning plan for running qwen3-14b-q4_K_M locally on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (16GB VRAM). Covers storage math, three quantization/offload configurations, and key llama-server flags (-ngl, -c, --flash-attn, --cache-type-k/v).

nodes.name: next.md

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand llama.cpp: an LLM/VLM inference engine in plain C/C++, built on the ggml tensor library, supporting CPU and many GPU backends.

tour.title: Core Tensor Library (ggml)
tour.description: ggml is the foundational tensor library. It provides the tensor data structure, operator graph, memory management, and backend dispatch. Start with the public header and the core source.

tour.title: LLaMA Inference Core
tour.description: The src/ directory contains the inference engine itself: model loading from GGUF, the KV cache, sampling, and the generation loop. llama.cpp and llama.h are the public entry points.

tour.title: Model Loading & Memory Mapping
tour.description: GGUF parsing, mmap-based zero-copy weight loading, and Direct I/O paths. See llama-model-loader and llama-mmap.

tour.title: KV Cache Subsystem
tour.description: The KV cache stores key/value tensors across layers. llama-kv-cells manages per-cell positions; llama-kv-cache implements the ring buffer, quantization, and serialization; llama-memory defines the abstract interface.

tour.title: CLI Tools
tour.description: llama-cli is the main interactive inference tool. llama-server provides an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API. Other tools support benchmarking, quantization, and perplexity measurement.

tour.title: Common Utilities
tour.description: Shared helpers used by all tools: argument parsing, logging, JSON handling, chat template rendering, and sampling configuration.

tour.title: Model Conversion (GGUF)
tour.description: Python scripts for converting models from Hugging Face and other formats into GGUF. convert_hf_to_gguf.py is the primary entry point.

tour.title: Build System
tour.description: CMake is the primary build system. CMakeLists.txt at the root drives the build; cmake/ contains helper modules. The Makefile provides a simpler alternative.

tour.title: Personal Study Notes (ctx/)
tour.description: The ctx/ directory contains personal hardware tuning notes and a KV-cache study plan. Useful if you want a guided reading order for the inference core.
